# Security policy

## Supported versions

UI Tweens is pre-release software. Only the latest tagged version gets fixes.

## Report a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue for a security problem.

Use **Report a vulnerability** on this repository's **Security** tab. Include the affected version, steps to reproduce and the impact you expect.

You'll get a reply as soon as possible. Once there's a fix, it will be released and noted in the changelog.
